description: Compare two strings and return every standard similarity measure in one call: Levenshtein and Damerau-Levenshtein edit distance, normalised similarity, Jaro and Jaro-Winkler, longest common subsequence, Dice coefficient on character bigrams, and the Soundex, Metaphone and NYSIIS phonetic keys of each string. Optional case folding, accent folding and whitespace normalisation before comparison. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

a.description: First string, at most 512 characters. Accepted: at most 512 characters.

b.description: Second string, at most 512 characters. Accepted: at most 512 characters.

fold.description: Comma-separated folds before comparing: case, accents, space, punct. Default case. Accepted: comma-separated subset of case, accents, space, punct.

only.description: Comma-separated measure names to compute: levenshtein, damerau_levenshtein, normalised_similarity, jaro, jaro_winkler, lcs_length, dice, phonetic (all three keys), soundex, metaphone, nysiis. Default all. Accepted: comma-separated subset of levenshtein, damerau_levenshtein, normalised_similarity, jaro, jaro_winkler, lcs_length, dice, phonetic, soundex, metaphone, nysiis.

name: text_similarity
title: String distance and phonetic keys: Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, Soundex, Metaphone
